metadata.source: Working tree; existing uncommitted edits preserved
metadata.surfaceOutput: Isolated nested Hyprland headless 1920x1200@60, scale 1; native Intel ADL GT2 OpenGL
metadata.surfaceBlur: Hyprland blur size 8, passes 2; theme transparency 0.88; compositor animations disabled
metadata.surfaceTrials: Fresh Quickshell process; 2s idle baseline; activate; 2.5s settle; six ~1s intervals; 2s after close
metadata.surfaceFixtures: 16 512x512 images; embedded player/art/lyrics; 18 Wi-Fi, 12 Bluetooth and 12 audio nodes; 76% battery; 100-notification burst; real portrait GIF
metadata.surfaceVideo: Existing 1920x1200 24 FPS H.264 proxy from active wallpaper source; hardware video engine observed
metadata.safety: Isolated XDG directories; no session D-Bus/PipeWire connection; inert wallpaper CLI; logind/power idle actions disabled; lock visual tree uses Item instead of secure protocol surface
metadata.baseline: 50 samples across 36 cases before consumer-owned GPU sampling, reserved label widths and running-only expiry pause
metadata.optimized: Two samples each: collapsed, visible System, synthetic 9/10% CPU-label alternation
metadata.corrected: One follow-up each: Wallpaper Studio, Network with QObject fixtures, lock with complete auth fixture, 100-notification burst/drawer, five popups; notification pause guard enabled
metadata.units: CPU percent of one core, GPU per-engine busy percentages, RAM KiB/MiB as labelled. Never add render to video or DRM graphics memory to PSS.
limits: Short settled samples are screening evidence, not startup latency, presentation FPS, tail latency, power or thermal soak.
Service data are fixtures; native radio/audio/tray daemon and secure lock/PAM action costs are not benchmarked.
Video decode/render frames were not counted in surface tests; lower decoder busy under blur may reflect throughput effects, not efficiency.
PSS deltas include allocator/cache retention and settling; negative deltas do not mean a surface has negative memory cost.
Transient helper work between snapshots may be missed. GPU sampling costs vary with desktop process and FD counts.
General idle compositor results vary strongly even without width changes; do not infer a universal idle-GPU saving from medians.

liveWeighted.memoryTiming: Latest collected PSS per process, nominal snapshots at 0/30/60/90 seconds. Exact per-process PSS timestamps are not retained. Memory aggregates include processes in the final matched interval; unreadable PSS is omitted and counted.
limits: Only readable process counters are available; root-owned PSS/GPU data may be inaccessible.
CPU percentages for processes are relative to one core; system CPU is relative to all cores.
GPU client IDs shared between processes are counted once and assigned to the lowest owner PID.
Very short-lived processes and unreadable GPU clients may be missed.
Some process PSS measurements may precede the end of sampling.
Groups use nearest named ancestor; Zestify and Codex descendants are separated from Kitty/Hyprland ancestors, and the observer is a separate group.
CPU/GPU means are duration weighted; full-capture contributions are lower bounds for processes missing unobserved startup/exit work.
No PID reuse or shared GPU clients were observed; this postprocessor rejects them rather than inventing ownership.
DRM memory fields describe referenced graphics buffers and may overlap other clients or CPU memory; do not add them to RAM/PSS or each other.
GPU render/video percentages describe independent engine classes and must not be added.
